title: Mobile App Development for Entrepreneurs
workloadNotes: Semester-long team project course structured as a series of graded presentations (elevator pitch, company analysis, app design, persona/mockup, two MVP showcase-and-feedback cycles) plus daily participation tracking. Does not teach mobile programming directly; students learn the platform independently. Exact grading percentages were hosted on an off-repo Syllabus/Schedule page not present in this source and so were not captured.
